Introduction

Working at the intersection of PR, media, digital influence and personal branding.

Ali Haider is a PR strategist and media entrepreneur — the founder of Connect PR, a private communications agency established in 2018.

His work spans public relations, media relations, personal branding and reputation, helping entrepreneurs, influencers, public figures and emerging brands build visibility and strengthen their presence in the public eye — connecting the right people and brands with the right opportunities, audiences and media.

The Story

How it started.

2018

Founded Connect PR.

What began as an early interest in social media and digital culture evolved into a private PR and communications business serving clients internationally. Through it, Haider built a network spanning media, entertainment, fashion and digital platforms — work centered on strategic positioning, one relationship at a time.
